docs.title: Strategies for clean desktops, effective file management
docs.text:
Got a meeting and you are stuck looking for files on your desktop?

Let's organize your desktop with these simple ways

  1. Don't save files on desktop or on C: drive as you will fill up that space which would be needed to install software.
  2. Save files in other drives
  3. If your work involves having many files on daily basis create folders according to dates that means name your folder with today's date.
  4. Create separate folders for every project you are working on and save the relevant files, you can create sub folder based on your needs.

In this way you may avoid clutter and fetch the files immediately even if it's last minute.

Thanks for reading!!!

docs.title: Just a heartfelt piece from an Electronics Engineer
docs.text:
When I wanted to take admission in engineering I didn't know which field to choose and I ended up choosing Electronics Engineering.

As I went ahead with my studies I realized that Electronics Engineering is the study of both Hardware and Software.

If in one subject we were learning a programming language then in another we were learning circuits, it's like the best of both worlds of Engineering.

That's what I enjoyed the most incorporating both hardware and software in my college project. Assembling all the electronic components, connecting them with particular wires, installing code and checking if our small robot we made works accordingly or not. This I think is one of the wonders of Electronics Engineering where we can connect both hardware and software and make a tangible product.

Having studied in this branch had broadened my perspective of technology that there are so many things and so many other things that can be done.

From an Electronics Engineer

Thanks for reading!!!

docs.title: Have you ever wanted to know what kind of style a website is using?
docs.text:
Well, there is a simple way to find that.

  1. Hover over the content of the website and right-click.

  2. There, you can see the "Inspect" option. Click on it.

  3. You will see a tab open on the right side of the page titled DevTools.

  4. If you click on the three dots in the top right corner of DevTools, you will be able to adjust its positioning.
  5. The image below represents the HTML of the website page. You can edit it and see the changes on the site. The changes you make here are temporary and will disappear once you reload the website.
  6. The image below represents the styling of the website page.

In this way, you can inspect the website.

Thanks for reading!!!

docs.title: Basic setup for XML on VS Code
Formatting your XML file
docs.text:
XML is Extensible Markup Language like HTML but with customizable tags.

Visual Studio Code (VS Code) is a code editor. You can Install it with this link https://code.visualstudio.com/download

Following are the steps

  1. Open VS Code
  2. Open any folder where you would like to save your file

  3. Create a new file with .xml extension

  4. Below is a simple xml code

    <first> Hello <second>World! </second></first>

  5. On left bar of VS Code, you will see an extension icon

  6. Search for “XML”. You can install any extension based on your requirements. For now, we are installing the second option, which is “XML Tools”.

  7. After installation, right-click in the XML file and you will see the "Format Document" option.

  8. On clicking "Format Document," your XML file gets formatted

In this way you can easily format your XML file in VS Code.

Thanks for reading!!!
